overlay.basis: Read by a person from aagento-bridge hume-pipe-rule-engine.ts (HumePipeRules interface, lines 3-103, documents mm vs m per field in comments) and hume-pipe.defaults.ts. Levels (rl/fl/hfl/bl/scourLevel/floorLevel and their inputs) are in metres; most construction sizes (wall, bedding, curtain/toe/face wall, graded gravel) are in millimetres; formation widths, wing wall length, barrel length, cushion height and founding depth are in metres, matching the interface comments.

findings.text: the family defaults store faceWallTier1Width as 1.360 and faceWallBaseWidth as 1.760 (metres-scale numbers) while the rule engine treats both as millimetres and falls back to 1360 / 1760 only when the field is absent: because 1.36 and 1.76 are truthy, the stored defaults are used AS mm, making the defaulted face wall tiers about 1000x too narrow.

compute() reads fields the family defaults do not hold; the code then uses its own constants: faceWallShelfDrop → 200.0, faceWallShelfProj → 250.0, flowDirection → None, flow_dir → None, gradedGravelDepth → 1200.0, hydraulics → None, toeWallBeddingProj → 150.0, toeWallBeddingThk → 150.0, toeWallProjection → 500.0, toeWallStemBotW → 300.0, toeWallStemH → 1700.0, toeWallStemTopW → 300.0
